duration: As stated in the agreement or to be refined in review.
effective_date: Upon full execution by the parties unless otherwise specified.
payment_terms: Administrator may pay funeral bills and urgent property expenses first and keep receipts. Administrator is entitled to reimbursement for reasonable costs incurred in administering the estate. Monthly accounting updates must be provided. Distributions occur only after debts and taxes are handled.
purpose: Set clear rules for administering a late father's estate, including payment priority for funeral and urgent property expenses, reimbursement of reasonable costs, monthly accounting, restrictions on selling major assets, timing of distributions after debts and taxes, replacement upon resignation, and confidentiality regarding family finances.
title: Agreement
